summary.text: Adam Thomas is a Republican who represents Kansas Senate District 23 in Johnson County and has served in the Senate since 2025, after serving in the Kansas House from 2019 to 2024.
He is vice chair of the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Kansas Legislature profile, Thomas's occupation is mortgage loan officer, and his spouse is Kristin Thomas.

His committee assignments also include Federal and State Affairs, Government Efficiency, and Public Health and Welfare, the Special Committee on Protecting Children from Online Harm, and the Joint Committee on Child Welfare System Oversight.
